title: Your First Shader from ZERO in Godot 4 | GDQuest Library
excerpt: Create your first shader in Godot. Implement texture sampling, shift shader UV coordinates, mask regions, and use noise to generate random shapes that make up a portal.
content_html:
Don't stop here. Step-by-step tutorials are fun but they only take you so far.
